title: Hum removal
summary: Cut the mains hum and its harmonics (50 or 60 Hz, found in the recording or stated), each by a set depth, whether or not a harmonic stands out. Static and zero-phase. line_reduce instead finds each line and cuts it until it matches its surroundings.

params.title: Mains frequency
params.help: auto looks for 50 or 60 Hz hum in the recording and cuts nothing if there is none. The exact frequency is measured from the lines found.

params.title: Harmonics
params.help: How many multiples of the mains frequency to cut, the fundamental included.

params.title: Width
params.help: At the fundamental; 10 % wider for each harmonic above it, where the mains frequency's drift is multiplied.

binding_hints.note: auto uses the hum found in the recording.
